review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for existing versions of each definition. Definitions checked: AddCircle.toCircle_addChar, ZMod.toCircle, ZMod.stdAddChar, ZMod.rootsOfUnityAddChar, rootsOfUnitytoCircle and rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv. For the last two, rootsOfUnityCircleEquiv is already built from the existing rootsOfUnityUnitsMulEquiv and restrictRootsOfUnity. I found no existing map from the n-th roots of unity in ℂ to Circle, so I did not flag it. The only overlap found is AddChar.zmod in Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/FiniteAbelian/PontryaginDuality.lean, which that file builds without importing the target. The overlap is partial: AddChar.zmod n x is a family of characters indexed by x, and the file would need extra imports. So ZMod.toCircle is a specialisation, which may be an intentional choice. That is why confidence is moderate to low.

findings.problem: ZMod.toCircle is the circle-valued additive character of ZMod N built from AddCircle.toCircle and ZMod.toAddCircle. Mathlib already has the same character in AddChar.zmod n x, which is defined as AddChar.compAddMonoidHom of bundled AddCircle.toCircle applied to ZMod.toAddCircle.comp (.mulLeft x). Taking x = 1 gives ZMod.toCircle, since 1 * y = y. That file also proves injectivity (AddChar.zmod_injective), a formula on integer casts (zmod_intCast), and AddChar.zmodHom. This file re-proves the injectivity and the formula as injective_toCircle and toCircle_intCast. The bundling of AddCircle.toCircle as an AddChar is also done twice: here as AddCircle.toCircle_addChar, and anonymously in PontryaginDuality line 49. The two parallel developments are not linked by any lemma.
findings.proposed_change: Prove one lemma that ZMod.toCircle equals AddChar.zmod N 1 (or mulShift of it) and derive one development from the other. Alternatively, define AddChar.zmod in terms of ZMod.toCircle.mulShift x. Make PontryaginDuality use AddCircle.toCircle_addChar instead of re-bundling ⟨AddCircle.toCircle, AddCircle.toCircle_zero, AddCircle.toCircle_add⟩. This needs checking the import direction, because PontryaginDuality does not currently import this file.
findings.benefit: This leaves one canonical circle-valued character on ZMod N. The injectivity and cast-formula proofs are not duplicated. Users of the Fourier and Pontryagin material and of the Gauss-sum material can pass between ZMod.toCircle and AddChar.zmod without redoing the exponent computation.
